signature.name: Kok Tobe Tower
signature.detail: The city's most famous landmark, a TV tower on a hill above Almaty with sweeping views over the mountains and the city. Ride the cable car up from the city center, or take a taxi; go in the late afternoon for the best light and fewer crowds.

signature.name: Ascension Cathedral
signature.detail: A striking wooden cathedral in Panfilov Park, famous for being built without nails and surviving earthquakes. It is an active church, so dress modestly and keep quiet inside; visit in the morning when it is quieter.

signature.name: Medeu
signature.detail: A high-altitude mountain sports complex in a dramatic gorge, a classic Almaty excursion. Check opening times before you go and bring a warm layer, as it sits well above the city and is much cooler.

signature.name: Shymbulak
signature.detail: A mountain resort reached by cable car from Medeu, popular for skiing in winter and hiking in summer. Go on a clear day for the best views and buy your cable car ticket at the base station.

signature.name: Big Almaty Lake
signature.detail: A turquoise alpine lake set in the mountains above the city, one of the region's most photographed sights. Access can be restricted at times, so check locally before setting out, and go early to avoid afternoon traffic.

signature.name: Panfilov Park
signature.detail: A leafy central park that holds the Ascension Cathedral and the Golden Warrior Monument, an easy and pleasant stop. It is free to enter and best visited on a mild morning combined with the nearby cathedral.

signature.name: Central State Museum of Kazakhstan
signature.detail: The country's main museum, with collections on Kazakh history, archaeology and culture. Allow a couple of hours, and check the day's opening hours since museums here often close one day a week.

signature.name: Zelionyj Bazar
signature.detail: A lively green market where you can see local produce, dried fruit, spices and dairy. Go in the morning when it is busiest and freshest, and bring small cash for purchases.

transport: Metro about $0.30 a ride; taxis cheap
